title: No Such Role
description: SwiftCargo only recognizes four crew roles. A registration attempt claiming an invented role, like "superadmin", shouldn't be allowed to slip through.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/register with role set to a value outside admin, dispatcher, driver, customer (e.g. "superadmin") returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR, and no account is created — a subsequent login attempt with that same email and password returns 401, not a successful session.
hints: The valid role enum is admin | dispatcher | driver | customer, checked by the registerSchema before any database write happens.
Confirm no account was created by trying to log in with the rejected email/password afterward, rather than assuming from the 400 alone.
